principle: Every claimed BenchIO capability must have a deterministic bench acceptance test before schematic authority opens.

tests.method: cold-plug/replug enumeration on accepted POS donor
tests.pass: stable enumeration and revision identity across repeated cycles

tests.method: loopback plus known Modbus/RS-485 device transaction
tests.pass: repeatable bidirectional transaction with bounded error count
repeatable bidirectional transaction with bounded error count

tests.method: known CAN node transaction at frozen bitrate
tests.pass: valid frames transmitted/received without protocol error escalation

tests.method: apply frozen low/high voltages through known source
tests.pass: all channels switch only inside documented thresholds

tests.method: switch bounded resistive loads and measure output
tests.pass: all channels meet frozen voltage/current/thermal limits

tests.claim: unsafe outputs are not active by default
tests.pass: field outputs remain inactive until explicit command

tests.claim: sidecar is stable for intended bench use
tests.method: representative I/O/network workload for frozen duration
tests.pass: no reset, overheating, latch-up, communication collapse or unsafe output

evidence_receipt_requires: test equipment identity where measurement is material
